description: This Java class 'FinalPrice' is a data model used to represent different price information for a product in a catalog, including discounted price, original price, final price, discount details, and related product price.

classes.name: FinalPrice
classes.description: A transient entity for displaying different price information in the product/catalog context.

methods.name: getAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Returns a list of additional final prices related to this price.

methods.name: setAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Sets the list of additional prices.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the original price before any discounts.

methods.name: getDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Gets the date when the discount ends.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Checks whether the product is discounted.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price, discounted or not.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets whether this is the default price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks if this is the default price.
